data.body: Plan review certified (83ca81e709e); claimed. Probe confirmed fast-import writes get-mark replies to stdout when --cat-blob-fd is absent (two marks read back via readline, exit 0). Commit f6fe5410a74 on branch fix-collapse-windows: FastImportSession now uses stdout=PIPE with no os.pipe and no pass_fds. New regression test test_streamed_engine_does_not_need_pass_fds wraps Popen to raise "pass_fds not supported on Windows." the way CPython does; it failed before the change and passes after it. All 14 collapse tests pass; lint and typecheck clean. Note: this worktree is based on main, which does not yet contain the separate euhedral-svelte-chimpanzee fix (Gerrit 3413); the two changes touch different functions. make verify running.
